title: ho mubarak fatima ka dilruba paida hua
body:
ho mubarak fatima ka dilruba paida hua
do jaha'n me teesra haajat rawa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
baade shaahe la fata qaibar kusha yasoobe dee'n
maaliko muqtaar taaje innama paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
di qabar jibreel ne aakar rasool allah ko
mujtaba paida hua lo mujtaba paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya roushan madina jiske noore paak se
aaj wo aalam me noore kibriya paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zabaa'n par jinno insa'n o malaaek ke yahi
janasheene mustafa o murataza paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
kibriya ne ki sana jiski kalaame paak me
wo shahe moujuz numa salle ala paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hoor o ghulma keh rahe hai hoke qush firdaus me
qaanaye zahra me sibte mustafa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jiski qatir hazrate eesa falak se aaye hai
wo shahe kounain o faqre ambiya paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
eid ke din mustafa jiske liye ushtar bane
wo ali e murtaza ka dilruba paida hua
